python.name: evaluate
python.signature: evaluate(observed: Mapping, gold: Mapping, *, limits: Mapping|None = None, review: Mapping|None = None) -> dict
python.note: INTERFACES.md section 5 names evaluate(observed, gold); limits and review are additive keyword-only extensions with defaults, so the frozen call shape still works.

interface_deviations.what: du-gold/1 fact gains two optional fields: quantity_basis and modality, and role.
interface_deviations.why: Without a declared modality the oracle cannot distinguish 'a plan restated as actual' from a legitimate actual, and without quantity_basis it cannot catch total-vs-increment paraphrases. Field absence still means unknown and does not trigger review.
interface_deviations.impact_on_others: none; additive and optional, both default to 'unknown'

interface_deviations.what: du-observed/1 is read with selected_text as a first-class replayable field.
interface_deviations.why: A fact carried only by replayed selection text is a real recall, not an omission. This is how the native baseline is scored fairly.
interface_deviations.impact_on_others: none; ROOT adapters may omit it, in which case recall falls back to locator evidence

interface_deviations.what: evaluate() returns extra top-level keys: dimensions, not_evaluated, spot_read_list.
interface_deviations.why: The card requires per-dimension denominators and an independent-review list for ROOT.

A.what: gold and counterexamples frozen; current baseline real FAIL/PARTIAL recorded

commands.result: 4/4 FAIL on critical-fact recall; this is a real quality finding, not a test-engineering failure

A.note: The baseline was NOT required to be green first, and no production code was touched to change any of these numbers.

B.what: oracle unit + offline CLI green; deliberately bad observations must fail; independence and missing-field states pass

commands.result: 5 fixtures; 4 PASS, 1 PARTIAL (the intentionally opaque scan); mutations 53/53 applicable detected; sentinel stable

independence.note: Only observer.py imports company_wiki, and only to call the existing public parser/selector. The oracle itself is dependency-free.

B.missing_field_behaviour: Field absence yields unknown/NOT_EVALUATED, never a review gate and never a fake PASS.

C.what: native representative-sample replay, restoration/resource report, holdout list

commands.result: raw_all_unchanged=true, config_unchanged=true, 0 network / 0 model / 0 paid calls, 0 raw copies

C.key_baseline_finding: cn-ir had only 11 candidates and the selector took all 11, yet 9 of 10 gold facts are still absent. Recall failure there is NOT a budget/cap problem: the candidate generator never produced the facts. This independently confirms that raising max_selected cannot fix recall.

tests_not_run: The other two DU packages (profiles, structure) - not owned by this lane
Full repository test suite - the card says not to add the benchmark to daily CI and not to run the whole suite
Real LLM summary quality - needs ROOT's paid large node; 0 paid calls were made here
holdout recall - no holdout gold can be authored until the acquisition requests are fulfilled
known_gaps: US holdout is UNAVAILABLE: all four US documents read are development-set documents, and no other US original exists in the local roots checked.
No real US S-1/F-1, 8-K/6-K attachment container, or amended/original revision pair is covered.
H-share holdout rests on one company (Alibaba); a second H-share is requested.

context_completeness and role_modality_quantity are NOT_EVALUATED on the native baseline because the current selector emits no semantic units and no claims. They become measurable only after ROOT wires in the DU-STRUCTURE/DU-PROFILES packages.
Semantic entailment is NOT_EVALUATED without an independent review. Deterministic checks can prove absence and contradiction, never entailment.

The oracle detects quantity-unit mismatches, basis contradictions, subject swaps and lifecycle-stage advancement from a fixed vocabulary. Paraphrases outside that vocabulary are reported as NOT_EVALUATED rather than guessed, so recall measured here is a lower bound on the true defect set.
derived_space and time_resource limits are the benchmark's own defaults, not ROOT's production budget; ROOT should pass its real limits.
The 20 survey samples are development seeds, not blind holdout. No blind-test claim is made.
cn-h1, cn-annual, cn-ipo have no gold yet; gold was authored for the four samples where facts could be read from the original pages within budget.
not_yet_automatically_checkable: Whether a summary sentence is semantically entailed by its cited evidence (needs the independent large-node review; the result carries spot_read_list for it).
Whether a value is economically correct beyond its unit/period/basis labels (e.g. whether management's own arithmetic is right).
Whether a table row is complete when the table itself was never extracted.
Whether a bilingual pair is a true translation versus a different fact in the other language lane.
Whether a company plan is realistic; only whether it was stated as a plan or as an accomplished fact.
Chart/figure content, which the baseline never reads and no gold fact asserts.

acquisition_requests.what: two US 10-K/10-Q filings, one software and one industrial, from companies outside the development set
one real US S-1 or F-1 registration statement
one real 8-K or 6-K whose exhibit is itself a business document
one amended filing paired with its original for the same period
one second H-share annual report outside e-commerce

resource_observations.note: peak RSS is reported as measured=false rather than fabricated; the offline and native runs are separate processes and the harness did not instrument them for a reliable peak.

raw_preservation.evidence: raw_unchanged=true for all 4 native samples; raw_all_unchanged=true in the C-node report; the make_bindings helper verified 20/20 SHA matches without writing.

scratch_restore.note: cleanup_owned refuses to delete a directory that lacks the .du-bench-owned marker; a test asserts this.

next_root_action: Wire the benchmark into the ROOT integration: inject a real du-input/1 adapter through observer.observe_du_adapter so context_completeness and role_modality_quantity stop being NOT_EVALUATED, pass ROOT's real derived/time limits via evaluate(limits=...), run the independent semantic review over spot_read_list, and decide on the five acquisition requests so a real blind holdout can be authored.
